axes.proposal: Arabic text lives only in page files. Display = render(span) = page slice at resolved position minus a closed deletion list (footnote markers; intra-span paragraph break becomes one space). Sigla stay or the span ends before them. model:check asserts render(span)==slice-minus-markers for every span. A book's ayah quotation is displayed as the book printed it, with the Ayah row linked beside it and differences flagged, never substituted.
axes.dissent: Plan A 3.3 and 6.6 must drop rendering quoted ayat from Ayah; otherwise I dissent: it substitutes a reading into the commentator's words.

axes.proposal: Two records: Statement (Report, spans, speaker derived from the Report's voice and chain, Statement.role from ADR 0011) and Assertion (predicate from a closed vocabulary; value = spans | Mention object | parsed number+spans | classified enum+spans, span always shown; restsOn Statements). Every subject or object is a Mention id resolved through an Identification. Heading-subject identifications are explicit-in-text and reviewed in bulk.

Chain = ordered (Link|Gap) elements. Link: narrator Mention plus modeSpans[], with modeKey 1:1 with the printed lemma+person/number; abbreviations (ثنا, أنا) map to their full key and keep their span. Unmapped form fails the check. Gap marks ta'liq, mursal, balagha; its length is never inferred and no edge crosses it. Derived jazm/tamrid class. enclosedBy for quoted authors. Report voice includes reported-anonymous. Edition.riwayah chain.

One global Entity per person, Mention everywhere. An Identification needs a basis span other than the mention's own: EDITOR_NOTE, RIJAL_ENTRY, or SAME_WORK_EXPLICIT (incl. tarjama heading for its subject); an ambiguous isnad name is never explicit-in-text. No namaq-authored basis. Without a basis the name renders as text with no node. Competing sourced identifications are all DISPUTED. Reuse per identical chain segment within a work, applications listed.
axes.dissent: If a namaq-authored basis survives for isnad narrators, even as labelled text, I dissent: that is our opinion attached to a Prophetic chain.

axes.proposal: A Tradition groups unmerged Reports through Membership records with a typed basis (editor-takhrij span, atraf-index span, same-work explicit, namaq-authored). Wordings are never merged; diffs are computed. namaq-authored memberships are allowed for history and tafsir and labelled 'grouped by Namaq'. For marfu' reports, grouping needs a source span basis unless the owner rules otherwise.
overrides: plannerB (unrestricted labelled Namaq grouping for hadith)

axes.proposal: Publication is per record with minted ids. Revision = hash(record fields + sha256(render(span)) + witness id for every span reached). A re-anchor with identical rendered text keeps the publication; any change in displayed text or witness lapses exactly those records and lists them. Only the owner runs model:publish on a change set; agents never set published. Mark-reviewed stays separate.

Authored: data/works/<work>/(work, editions, witnesses, units/*.yaml), data/history/sources/<edition>/<witness>/v<n>/, data/entities/, data/glosses/ for labelled English names. Change sets are PRs listing record ids. catalog/ and batches/ retired; seeds and old excerpts archived read-only. PG and Neo4j derived. NARRATED_FROM in a separate isnad view, only from reviewed identifications, never across a Gap, carrying modeKey and span ids, excluded from centrality. ADR supersedes 0010's layout.

Phase 0: decisions/ADRs and freeze. Then text core (spans, render, check). Then Siyar conversion with voice per report, review surface live, LegacyValue displayed. Then projection with a pre-model tag, dual tables for one release and a rollback criterion. Then Siyar chains. Then one Bukhari kitab pilot, measured against the estimate as a go/no-go. Then a tafsir pilot.

Records Work/Edition/Volume/Witness. Witness flags per volume range: vowelled, footnotes, host-inserted ligatures. Shamela only until the owner changes the rule. Bare Sira v1-2 shown with a fidelity flag. Edition.numbering mapping table, with the Bukhari edition and display scheme chosen by the owner. Edition.riwayah. The Ayah mushaf and qira'a are named in an ADR. Quoted ayat are linked, not substituted.

Agents propose; the owner reviews and publishes. Statements whose final identified speaker is the Prophet ﷺ need: a complete chain record with explicit gaps, no default speaker, no LEGACY, honorifics as printed, and two distinct recorded reviewers, one hadith-trained. Until a second reviewer exists they stay PROPOSED, visibly. The per-record review surface ships before scale. Identifications are reviewed per chain segment, budgeted from A's cost table.

ADR 0008 holds: source text and statements are shown with their status, and LEGACY values are shown as 'no source yet' until close-out. Our unreviewed judgments (identifications, namaq groupings, classified values) show as labelled text only, never as graph edges. For Prophetic statements there is no LEGACY, and no edge, grouping or grade label appears before the P10 gate passes. An ADR records the scope.

extras.rule_or_trigger: Before phase 1, an ADR records Shamela's terms for re-hosting transcriptions and how the app attributes them; publishing waits on it.
Trigger: the search rewrite after the projection phase. A search-only normalised index derived from render(span), never displayed.
Quiz questions cite record ids; a lapsed or changed cited record unpublishes the question until it is re-reviewed under docs/quiz-question-review.md.
Each review records the reviewer's identity and qualification; P10 counts two distinct reviewers, one hadith-qualified; the owner names them.
Witness records 'not checked against print'; Prophetic matn spans need a page-image check by a reviewer before passing P10.
A re-fetch or normalisation bump that changes the rendered text of a published Prophetic matn lapses it into P10 re-review; no automatic re-anchor across text change.
Abbreviations map to full modeKeys and keep their own span; idraj and doubt words are Statement insertions with speaker, never part of the matn wording.
Trigger: Bukhari pilot. Each cut piece is its own Report, joined by Tradition membership with basis; never reassembled into one text.
Editor footnote gradings are grading Statements with the editor as speaker. A siglum like (ع) is a span statement of the editor's or author's apparatus, defined per edition.
A segment identification is one record applied by reference; copies are never duplicated, so changing it re-lapses every application, all listed.
Trigger: phase 0 decisions. The ADR names the Ayah mushaf/qira'a and the rijal work (e.g. Tahdhib al-Kamal); it is ingested before the Siyar chains phase.
Resolution is cached per page hash and normalisation version; Vitest covers projection of disputed edges, gap non-crossing, and resolution time on the pilot corpus.
